answer_1.quote: We evaluate EAGLE and other LVLMs in multimodal conversation task on the Quilt-conversation dataset, and use relative score (Seyfioglu et al., 2024) and Elo rating (Chiang et al., 2024) as metrics.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include answers to visual questions and responses in multimodal conversations based on histopathological images.

answer_2.quote: In Table 2, we quantitatively evaluate our EAGLE and other LVLMs on VQA with visual prompting (VQA w/ V.P.) task.

answer_3.quote: In Elo rating, we compare responses generated by different LVLMs and record the preferred reponses via GPT-4, which gives us a record of the winning rate between pairs of different LVLMs.
